status: Read-only source and CPU initial-pose audit; no runner or weight changes; no training
conclusion: No evidence of reward implementation forcing a bowed torso or low head. Root-height target is selected repaired root height, not robot nominal stand_height; chest reward acts on FK torso world rotation and remains differentiable. Physical drift can still result from model gradient error or unconstrained policy drift.

root_height.implementation: Wide initial_state replaces generic robot height with config initial_height. Simulator context is created AFTER reset and terrain penetration correction; height_anchor is actual reset rootZ. Height term uses rootZ error with5cm scale, maximized at that anchor.
root_height.coupling: Maintaining selected pelvis height while straightening tilted pelvis may require leg adjustment; height term does not directly reward bending. This is a potential optimization tradeoff, not demonstrated causal bug.

findings.pose_reward: No reference joint-pose or default-pose attraction in Fullbody reward. Terms are physical root/height/upright/velocity/feet/action-rate/limits and chest. Level0 aim contribution is zero. Neither head angle nor gaze is separately controlled.
findings.chest_gradient: task.kin.forward returns world body rotations; fk[1][:,task.torso] feeds local+Z vs world+Z. Torch trigonometry and matrix FK remain in autograd for WM actor rollout; no detach in chest reward path. Initial chest_upright=.74529636, contribution=.02981185/step; chest_excess=0. Prefers zero tilt; no downward target allowance at level0.
findings.root_upright: Uses world root rotation R[:,2,2], distinct from chest FK rotation. Initial kernel=.65773767, contribution=.01315475; improving root and chest upright is encouraged but joint coupling can create transient competition.
findings.action_reference: MDP default_q is RobotSpec default, while reset initial_q is selected repaired pose. This is intentional teacher-compatible action coordinates: q_des=default_q+xi_offset+alpha*raw, soft limit clamp; reset previous action=(initial_q-default_q-offset)/alpha. Simulator asserts native default consistency. Changing default_q to initial_q without migrating output/obs/WM would be incorrect.
findings.normalization: Tracker transfer preserves teacher observation normalization and first93 goal statistics, folds constant repaired pose condition and pose_skip into biases, adds14 command inputs with zero weights. Teacher normalizers frozen. Actual contact inputs change teacher fixed-support vs student initially zero; distillation exists to adapt this interface. Frozen statistics may become out-of-distribution after full actor drift, but no evidence of a coordinate mismatch.
findings.wm_physical_match: Both imagined reward and physical reward call the same task reward on next state, including FK torso world rotations; no root-only replacement for chest. Reward equality does not guarantee WM gradients match real contact dynamics.

minimal_next_actions.action: No corrective reward patch justified yet. Compare per-term physical and imagined rewards on identical failure states, with actual FK chest rotations and pelvis/root heights.
minimal_next_actions.execution: Use recorded rollout NPZ/state history; CPU FK or deferred GPU after training releases resource.

minimal_next_actions.action: CPU action-coordinate regression on selected state and random validxi: raw=(q-default-offset)/alpha, compose_action(raw,xi) must recover q; teacher-transferred output parity should use repaired q.
minimal_next_actions.purpose: Rule out adapter/reference coordinate mistakes before tuning rewards.

minimal_next_actions.action: If physical height tradeoff is demonstrated, prepare separate versioned branch reducing only height weight or widening only height scale; preserve upright/chest acceptance and compare against same checkpoint/seeds.
minimal_next_actions.caution: Do not lower reference height or change default_q merely because robot crouches. No such fix applied.

minimal_next_actions.action: If actor changes chest/root despite favorable true gradients, constrain parameter/action drift or improve current-policy WM validation in isolated branch; gradient decomposition from other audit should select intervention.
minimal_next_actions.caution: Reward-only tail removal already failed physically, so bootstrap alone is not a sufficient diagnosis.

limitations: CPU probe is initial pose only; does not establish rollout gradients or stability
